primary_source_method: Published AFINO-based Fourier model-comparison classification as recorded by BAII; exact source-version metadata preserved in F3A.2 provenance.

allowed_project_reference_roles.PUBLISHED_QPP_REFERENCE: Primary-source event selected as QPP before F3A. Never interpreted as physical ground truth.
allowed_project_reference_roles.PUBLISHED_NOT_SELECTED_REFERENCE: Primary-source flare not selected as QPP by the source procedure. Never interpreted as a true negative.
allowed_project_reference_roles.OTHER_EXTERNAL_CLASSIFIER_REFERENCE: External published classification, e.g. BAIIW0003, retained only as a separately sourced annotation/comparator label.
allowed_project_reference_roles.REFERENCE_LABEL_CONFLICT: Two independently sourced observational labels conflict for a deterministically cross-matched event.

conflict_policy.primary_analysis: Retain the BAIIW0001 role for the primary robustness question because cohort membership was frozen from that source.
conflict_policy.annotation: Flag REFERENCE_LABEL_CONFLICT and retain all external labels with independent provenance.
conflict_policy.secondary_agreement_analysis: May be descriptive only if cross-match and external label provenance are deterministic before execution.

baseline_classifier: AFINO execution contract inherited from F0-F2, applied only after cohort freeze to W00/P00/seed0.
external_classifier_policy: External classifier outputs are never silently merged with primary labels and do not redefine cohort membership.
